import asyncio
from asyncio import base_events
from asyncio import events


async def connect() -> None:
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    await loop.create_connection(protocol_factory, "localhost", 80)


async def connect_from_defining_type(loop: base_events.BaseEventLoop) -> None:
    await loop.create_connection(protocol_factory, "localhost", 80)


async def connect_from_abstract_type(loop: events.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    await loop.create_connection(protocol_factory, "localhost", 80)
